From kayaking and paddleboarding to obstacle courses, water slides, and even swim-up bars, it’s one of the most unique ways to spend a day on the water. The largest one, Mirada, spans 15 acres, making it one of the biggest man-made lagoons in the country. Heading south? There’s also Brightwater Lagoon in North Fort Myers.
